_comment: Lane RELNOTES-1: which community pull requests each Release-note line of a merge came from, for merges already in the history whose lines do not end with their own (#12) (nightly_notes.py note_credits; docs/RELEASE.md, Nightly builds). Key: the merge's full commit id; value: one list of pull request numbers per Release-note line of that merge, in order ([] = our own work). A row wins over the lines' own endings. New merges need no row: end each credited Release-note line with (#12) or (#12, #13).
